jobs.title: CAD Kernel Engineer
jobs.summary: Work on the geometry engine that transforms AI-generated engineering instructions into valid, manufacturable CAD models and industry-standard file formats.
jobs.about: ORAIN is building an AI-native engineering platform capable of generating manufacturable CAD geometry directly from natural language instructions. As a CAD Kernel Engineer, you will work on the geometry engine that transforms AI-generated programs into valid CAD models and industry-standard file formats.
responsibilities: Develop and maintain CAD kernel integrations and geometry pipelines.
Work with STEP, IGES, BREP and other CAD file structures.
Build geometry validation and repair systems.
Design feature tree and topology handling mechanisms.
Collaborate closely with AI researchers to convert generated geometry instructions into executable CAD operations.
Improve geometry robustness, manufacturability and interoperability.
requiredSkills: Strong experience with OpenCascade or equivalent CAD kernels.
Deep understanding of CAD data structures and geometric modelling.
Experience with STEP, IGES and BREP formats.
Knowledge of topology and feature-based modelling.
Familiarity with SolidWorks API, FreeCAD internals or similar CAD frameworks.
preferredQualifications: Experience building CAD software or CAD plugins.
Contributions to geometry processing or CAD open-source projects.

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer
jobs.summary: Research and develop multimodal AI systems capable of understanding engineering intent and generating geometry-aware outputs for CAD generation.
jobs.about: You will design and train large multimodal AI systems capable of understanding engineering intent and generating geometry-aware outputs for CAD generation.
responsibilities: Fine-tune large language and multimodal models.
Build geometry datasets and synthetic training pipelines.
Improve model accuracy, reasoning and generation capabilities.
Work closely with geometry and mechanical engineering teams.
requiredSkills: Experience with LoRA and QLoRA fine-tuning techniques.
Familiarity with RLHF and DPO optimisation techniques.

jobs.title: Computational Geometry Research Engineer
jobs.summary: Research mathematical representations and reasoning systems for engineering geometry, focusing on topology, graph structures and geometric intelligence algorithms.
jobs.about: This role focuses on the mathematical representation and reasoning of geometry. Unlike traditional CAD engineering roles, this position deals with topology, graph structures and geometric intelligence algorithms.
responsibilities: Work on surface and topology representations.
Support AI researchers with geometry abstractions suitable for model training.
requiredSkills: Strong mathematical background in geometry and optimisation.
Proficiency in C++, Python or both.
preferredQualifications: Experience in computer graphics or robotics.
Publications in geometry, graphics or computational design are highly desirable.

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.summary: Provide the engineering ground truth required to ensure AI-generated designs are technically sound, practical and manufacturable.
jobs.about: Mechanical Design Engineers act as ORAIN's engineering ground truth layer. They provide the design knowledge, engineering standards and validation required to ensure generated outputs are practical and manufacturable.
responsibilities: Define design standards and best practices.
Assist with benchmarking and evaluation frameworks.
Support development of engineering design guidelines.
requiredSkills: Strong experience with SolidWorks, CATIA or Siemens NX.
Knowledge of Design for Manufacturing (DFM) principles.
Experience with GD&T and engineering standards.
Ability to review complex assemblies and components.
preferredQualifications: Experience in aerospace, automotive or industrial product design.
Experience working with simulation or CAE tools.
Experience creating engineering datasets or design automation systems.
